<p style="font: 10pt/115% Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"></p><table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">
<tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 0"/><td style="width: 1in"><b>Item 5.03</b></td><td><b>Amendments to Articles of Incorporation or Bylaws; Change in Fiscal Year.</b></td></tr>
</table>

<p style="font: 10pt/115% Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><span style="font-size: 10pt"></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt/115% Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><span style="font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt/115% Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Effective January 23, 2026, the Company amended its governing
documents to change its corporate name from Renewal Fuels, Inc. to American Fusion Inc.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt/115% Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt/115% Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Effective February 5, 2026, the Company completed its domestication
into the State of Texas, which was finalized in connection with the Company&#8217;s conversion out of Delaware effective February 10,
2026.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt/115% Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt/115% Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In connection with the foregoing corporate actions, the Financial
Industry Regulatory Authority (&#8220;FINRA&#8221;) processed a related corporate action, including the Company&#8217;s symbol change
to AMFN, which became effective March 17, 2026.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt/115% Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt/115% Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The Company&#8217;s fiscal year has not changed.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt/115% Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><span style="font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">
<tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 0"/><td style="width: 1in"><b>Item 8.01</b></td><td><b>Other Events.</b></td></tr>
</table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">On April 28, 2026,
Renewal Fuels, Inc. d/b/a American Fusion Inc. (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) issued a press release announcing the launch of a Government
Procurement Services operating segment and an initial transaction within that segment supporting a Canadian Department of National Defence
/ Quality Engineering Test Establishment procurement requirement.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">As described in the press
release, the transaction relates to the Company&#8217;s ancillary government and institutional procurement activities and is separate
from the Company&#8217;s core fusion energy development activities conducted through Kepler Fusion Technologies and the Texatron&#8482;
platform.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">A copy of the press release
is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K and is incorporated herein by reference.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">The information furnished
under this Item 8.01, including Exhibit 99.1, shall not be deemed &#8220;filed&#8221; for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange
Act of 1934, as amended, nor incorporated by reference into any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, except as expressly
set forth by specific reference in such filing.&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">&#160;</p>
